{{missing image|needs=Proper location map that doesn't also highlight elemental islands}} {{Infobox island |island=Shamouti Island |characters=アーシア島 |japanese=Earthia Island |image=Shamouti Island.png |size=300px |epnumber=M02 |eptitle=The Power of One |map=Shamouti.png }} [[File:Shamouti Fire Ice and Lightning Islands.png|thumb|left|200px|Aerial view of Shamouti Island (right), Lightning Island (top left), Ice Island (middle left), and Fire Island (bottom left)]] '''Shamouti Island''' (Japanese: '''アーシア{{tt|島|とう}}''' ''Earthia Island''; ''Arshia Island'' and ''Asia Island'' are also seen) is one of the [[Orange Islands]]. As depicted in ''[[M02|The Power of One]]'', Shamouti and its surrounding isles, [[Fire Island]], [[Ice Island]], and [[Lightning Island]], are connected to the balance of nature via the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{DL|Legendary birds (M02)|Moltres}}, {{DL|Legendary birds (M02)|Articuno}}, {{DL|Legendary birds (M02)|Zapdos}}, and their mediator {{OBP|Lugia|M02}}. Every year, Shamouti Island holds the annual [[Legend Festival]]. For centuries, the locals have performed a ceremony honoring the prophesied {{Ash|Chosen One}} that would tame the {{OBP|Legendary birds|M02|birds of legend}} should they release their might on the world. The locals dress up in traditional attire, apparently for historical purposes, but some in the younger generation attribute the preservation effort to the resulting tourism. According to {{an|Professor Oak}}, ancient writings from many different cultures name the area around this region as the source of all the waters of the world and perhaps life itself. ==Places of interest== ===Town=== The town is the centerpiece of Shamouti Island's annual festivities honoring the Chosen One who is supposed to bring harmony to the fighting legendary birds and help the beast of the sea quell their fighting. It is relatively modern; however, it retains its old traditions, with a totem pole at the town center. During the festival, a large bazaar is set up, where people can buy souvenirs for the occasion. {{OBP|Tobias|M02}} is the current community elder, while {{OBP|Melody|M02}} and her older sister [[Carol]] also live on Shamouti Island. [[File:Shamouti Island shrine.png|thumb|left|250px|Shamouti Island shrine]] ===Festival house=== The centerpoint of the festival is a large tiki hut, where a banquet is set up in honor of the Chosen One. Each year, a person is selected from the crowd to play the part of the Chosen One, journeying to Fire Island, Ice Island, and Lightning Island to retrieve the three treasures there. At the end, the festival maiden plays a song on her ocarina, and the festival ends for another year. ===Shrine=== A large shrine is present on the southern cliffs of Shamouti, overlooking Fire, Ice, and Lightning Islands, and is where the "Chosen One" is supposed to place the three treasures. Stone structures are set up around the altar in which the treasures are placed, and {{wp|hibiscus}} flowers grow all around. Shamouti Island's location is the highlighted square.]] *During the production of the second movie, its beta name was '''フォーポイント島''' ''Fourpoint Island''. *In the Japanese version of the second movie, a tour guide mentions that Shamouti is located in the "{{tt|オレンジ諸島の海の果てよ|outskirts of the Orange Islands}}", but in the English dub, she states it is in the center of the archipelago. A TV reporter in the English dub also mentions that the unusual weather activity is originating from "the north-central region of the Orange Islands". Onscreen, a digital map of the archipelago shows Shamouti to be isolated in a northeastern region. **However, later maps look completely different from the movie version and show Shamouti to be in the center. In addition to being located at the very center of the archipelago, it also lies within the same meridian as Mt. Silver, if one were to view the [[Orange Islands]] map. *Shamouti Island's shrine briefly appeared in the ending of ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', which follows [[I Choose You! trilogy|an alternate timeline]] compared to the main series. {{-}} ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="background: #{{orange color}}; border: 3px solid #{{orange color dark}}" !
